partners.name: For Zion Ministries
partners.story: Our first official ministry partnership. We hosted Keegan and For Zion Ministries — sat with them for a meeting, prayed over what comes next, and walked away with a clear sense that God is doing something with the young adults in Washington state. The four-movement evangelism guide on this site came out of training Keegan walked us through that week. Keegan also trained our team in LGBTQ+ evangelism — how to meet people exactly where they are with love, truth, and the Gospel without compromise.

contributions.label: The four-movement evangelism guide came out of training Keegan walked us through at our first partnership meeting.

partners.name: One Heart MVMT
partners.story: Sam Petrov and David Ageyev first met at Slavic Christian Awakening Church in Mukilteo, WA in 2025, and what started as a friendship has grown into one of our most active ministry partnerships. Sam officially launched One Heart MVMT on May 7, 2026 — a movement built around bringing churches together to reach people where they are. The Community Cookout events are the heartbeat of it: free food, prizes, a bouncy castle for the kids, and at the center of it all, the Gospel. Sam evangelizes, makes an altar call, and people receive healing and prayer — then they come to us for a Bible. Sam also intends to bring this same generosity to native tribal lands, children, and those in prison — and wherever God opens a door, we plan to walk through it together.
